as_told.title: Calf dies with a UFO caught on camera above it

plain: A healthy two-year-old heifer turned up dead on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, with "no exterior injuries", and a camera caught an object above it. Michels calls it one of the most disturbing things ever to happen there and credits the account to The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch, a series about the place. The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, tells it as something he was part of: "we captured on camera an object" in a field near Homestead 1, one of the ranch's houses, and he credits a witness named Thomas Winterton and a man named Caleb Benches. If true, it would tie something in the sky to an unexplained animal death.
